input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. input.text: Nisâ yüz yirmi beşinci ayet. وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًۭا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ وَٱتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًۭا ۗ وَٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ خَلِيلًۭا
